skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and explaining the essence of ecology
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the structure of ecology, its historical development, and its relationship with human development.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identifying ecological factors and their environmental impacts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize various ecological factors, understand their impact on biological life, and comprehend basic ecological laws and material-energy cycles.
Apply ecological principles to explain phenomena and assess human impacts on ecosystems.
Collaborate effectively in groups to solve ecological problems related to the environment.
Possess the ability to learn independently, research materials, and solve practical problems.
Adhere to class rules, demonstrate teamwork spirit, and take personal responsibility for assigned activities.
